description: Explains a term on relocation, residency, citizenship, tax and asset protection from the GoodbyeMatrix glossary (more than 120 terms, for example golden visa, 183-day rule, tax residency certificate, flag theory) with the glossary page in German and English. The definition is returned in the requested language (English or German); a term without an English entry yet comes with the German definition and a note. Related terms are listed when the search term matches several entries.

term.description: Term in English or German, for example "183-day rule" or "Wegzugsbesteuerung".

name: explain_term

definitionNote.description: Only when the English definition is not available yet and the German one is returned.

notice.description: General information, not legal, tax or immigration advice.

title: Explain a glossary term
